entries.official_publisher: South Australian Housing Trust (data sourced from Consumer and Business Services rental bond lodgements)
entries.direct_data_url: resolved per-quarter via CKAN API https://data.sa.gov.au/data/api/3/action/package_show?id=private-rent-report (72 resources, latest 2026-03)
entries.access_method: CKAN API + direct file_download, no bot protection (verified via plain curl)
entries.source_geography: Suburb, Postcode (PC), Region, SLA (Statistical Local Area — pre-2011 ASGS geography, needs its own correspondence to current SA2/LGA)
entries.source_grain: aggregate — median rent by dwelling type
entries.property_type_detail: flat/house breakdown (per notes: 'Flat/House totals have been rounded to the nearest 5')
entries.bedroom_detail: not yet confirmed — needs sheet inspection during adapter build
entries.price_rent_definition: median rent from rental bond dataset of the Tenancies Branch
entries.correction_republication_behaviour: not yet determined — each quarter is a separate resource on CKAN (unlike QLD's single overwritten file), so historical files are individually addressable and presumably stable once published
entries.approximate_file_size_mb: not yet measured precisely, single-quarter file downloaded successfully
entries.automation_suitability: high — CKAN API gives a reliable, scriptable current-file resolution mechanism (same pattern already used for VIC's VPSR discovery in Sprint 10)
entries.access_restrictions: documented small-cell suppression: '*' where 1-5 dwellings; rounding to nearest 5 for flat/house totals
entries.reason: Live-verified via CKAN API and direct download: genuine xlsx, CC BY licence, no bot protection, deep history (2008-2026), suburb+postcode+region+SLA grain
